boe.f: Initialism of based on experience, mentioned in job offers where compensation is to be negotiated.

s.g: (aircraft) An aircraft produced by the Boeing company.
s.x: Southwest Airlines' fleet consists of all Boeings, without a single Airbus.

s.g: (historical) An inhabitant or a resident of Boeotia.
(by extension) A dull or ignorant person.
(historical) A Dutch colonist in South Africa during the colonial era, especially a farmer.
A militant in the Boer War.
s.x: The British soldiers captured a Boer after the battle.

s.g: (derogatory, offensive) An Afrikaner, especially a farmer.
(South Africa) A type of sausage, usually flavoured with coriander seed, black pepper, nutmeg, cloves and allspice.
(South Africa, informal) A brother; often prefixed informally to a man’s first name.
(South Africa, informal) A familiar form of address: pal, mate.
